Define a list of path prefixes to skip the access-control to ease the configuration for the handler.yml so that users can define some endpoint without fine-grained access-control security even through it uses the default chain. This is useful if some endpoints want to skip the fine-grained access control in the application. The format is a list of strings separated with commas or a JSON list in values.yml definition from config server, or you can use yaml format in externalized access-control.yml file.
